description: This Java source file defines a class `TestModuleActivator` that extends `BaseModuleActivator` and implements lifecycle methods for starting, stopping, and refreshing the module, with logging statements.

classes.name: TestModuleActivator
classes.description: A class that manages the lifecycle events of an OpenMRS module, including start, stop, and refresh activities, with logging.

methods.name: willRefreshContext
methods.description: Invoked before the module's application context is refreshed, logs a message indicating refresh.

methods.name: contextRefreshed
methods.description: Invoked after the module's application context has been refreshed, logs a message indicating completion.

methods.name: willStart
methods.description: Invoked before the module starts, logs a starting message.

methods.name: started
methods.description: Invoked after the module has started, logs a started message.

methods.name: willStop
methods.description: Invoked before the module stops, logs a stopping message.

methods.name: stopped
methods.description: Invoked after the module has stopped, logs a message indicating stoppage.
